dedupe_keys.name: dair v2x and v2x seq real world vehicle infrastructure cooperative driving datasets roadside and vehicle sensors

description: DAIR-V2X is a real-world dataset for vehicle-to-everything (V2X) cooperative autonomous driving, pairing sensors mounted on vehicles with sensors mounted on roadside infrastructure at the same scenes. It is produced by the Institute for AI Industry Research (AIR) at Tsinghua University, with the dataset hosted on a Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence server, and was presented at CVPR 2022. Coverage: roads and intersections in China. DAIR-V2X holds 71,254 frames of camera images and 71,254 frames of lidar point clouds with 3D annotations; V2X-Seq (CVPR 2023) adds a sequential perception dataset of more than 15,000 frames from 95 scenarios and a trajectory forecasting dataset of about 80,000 infrastructure-side and cooperative scenarios with vector maps and traffic light states; the group also released RCooper for roadside cooperative perception. The OpenDAIR-V2X code base provides loaders, benchmarks and baselines for cooperative 3D detection, tracking and forecasting. Format and access: example files and the full datasets through the project page and shared drive folders, code on GitHub; free for research after accepting the dataset terms. Licence: code Apache 2.0; dataset terms on the project page (not read). Caveats: coverage is limited to the instrumented test roads, and roadside sensors reflect one deployment design. Simulation uses: studying how roadside sensors and V2X links improve traffic perception, for digital twin and capacity planning work on connected intersections. Related records: WiLabV2Xsim (model-wilabv2xsim) simulates the V2X radio links, and nuScenes (data-nuscenes-autonomous-driving-dataset) is a vehicle-only counterpart.
